verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents domain unlocking and transfer-out (leaving) via standard EPP mechanisms, and a Registrar API exists that could be used to pull domain/WHOIS data, but there is no explicit documentation of exporting account/domain data in open, portable formats. missing for 10: explicit data export feature/format documentation, evidence of exporting WHOIS/DNS records in open formats, independent confirmation of a full data-export workflow.
